name: Research
description: Roles for investigative research: a research analyst advisor, a lead researcher who produces the deliverable, and an independent fact-checker.

roles.label: Research Analyst
roles.description: Advises on research questions, sources, and method without producing the final deliverable.
responsibilities: Frame the research questions and candidate sources
Flag weak sourcing or unsupported conclusions

roles.label: Lead Researcher
roles.description: Investigates the assigned question and writes the research deliverable within an isolated worktree.
responsibilities: Gather and cite verifiable sources for the assigned question
Write the deliverable to the brief and acceptance criteria
Escalate when sources conflict or cannot be verified

roles.label: Fact Checker
roles.description: Independently verifies the claims and citations in a completed research deliverable.
responsibilities: Verify each material claim against its cited source
Report an explicit approve or reject decision with evidence
